topic: Troubleshooting device connectivity and data anomalies
summary_markdown:
A discussion was held regarding a specific advertising box (JCD_LT_VIL0005DB) that experienced intermittent connection loss and data anomalies. The connectivity issues were noted to occur consistently over three days, dropping around 11:00 and restoring near 20:00.

The device was replaced with a new unit (001E42333D6B). Following the replacement, it was determined that the box needed re-binding or re-linking to ensure proper display on the dashboard. Someone confirmed that they had already performed the necessary re-binding steps.
decisions: The problematic device required replacement with a new unit.
